record.question: In schizophrenia when an individual has disorganized speech the term 'clanging' refers to:
options: Individuals only communicate with words that rhymes
Answers to questions may not be relevant
Individuals communicate without completing their sentences
Speech may be neither structured nor comprehensible
record.explanation: Answer A: Individuals only communicate with words that rhymes. Clanging is speech driven by sound associations, such as rhyming words, rather than meaning. Reference: https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK546682/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
